description: This source file implements the SbMicrophonePrivate interface for Android, managing microphone access, permissions, OpenSL ES audio recording, buffer management, and JNI interactions for microphone control.

classes.name: SbMicrophoneImpl
classes.description: Implementation of SbMicrophonePrivate for Android, handling microphone permissions, OpenSL ES audio recording, buffer management, and JNI interactions.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::~SbMicrophoneImpl
methods.description: Destructor that calls Close() to ensure proper cleanup.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::IsMicrophoneDisconnected
methods.description: Checks if the microphone is disconnected via JNI.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::IsMicrophoneMute
methods.description: Checks if the microphone is muted via JNI.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::Open
methods.description: Opens the microphone, requests permission if needed, and starts recording.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::StartRecording
methods.description: Creates the audio recorder and enqueues buffers to start recording.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::Close
methods.description: Stops recording and cleans up resources.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::StopRecording
methods.description: Stops the recording process and clears buffers.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::Read
methods.description: Reads available audio data into provided buffer.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::SetPermission
methods.description: Sets permission state based on JNI callback.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::SwapAndPublishBuffer
methods.description: Static callback to swap buffers and publish them.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::SwapAndPublishBuffer
methods.description: Swaps buffers between delivered and ready queues, enqueues new buffers if open.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::CreateAudioRecorder
methods.description: Initializes OpenSL ES engine, creates and configures audio recorder.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::DeleteAudioRecorder
methods.description: Destroys OpenSL ES objects and cleans up.

methods.name: SbMicrophoneImpl::ClearBuffer
methods.description: Clears buffer queues and deletes allocated buffers.
